name: myelin transcription factor 1 like

function.text: MYT1L is the approved symbol for myelin transcription factor 1 like. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in cobalt ion binding; DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include syndromic complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); intellectual developmental disorder, autosomal dominant 39 (autosomal dominant). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Esophageal carcinoma; Pancreatic adenocarcinoma; Uterine carcinosarcoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: MYT1L encodes myelin transcription factor 1 like. Its functions include cobalt ion binding and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific.

germline.text: Germline disease associations include syndromic complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); intellectual developmental disorder, autosomal dominant 39 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MYT1L have been reported in esophageal carcinoma, uterine carcinosarcoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.
